messages.content: You can call create_event to add an appointment to the user's calendar.
Add a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room.

function.name: create_event
function.description: Create a new event on the user's calendar.

message.content:
<think>The user wants to add a meeting with the marketing team tomorrow at 2 PM for one hour in the main conference room. 

Tomorrow's date is 2024-06-05, so the meeting will be on 2024-06-05 at 14:00.

Let me calculate:
- Tomorrow: 2024-06-05
- Start time: 14:00 (2 PM)
- Duration: 1 hour (60 minutes)
- Location: main conference room
- Attendees: "marketing team" - I'll include this as an attendee

I need to create an event with:
- title: "Meeting with marketing team" or similar
- start_iso: 2024-06-05T14:00:00
- duration_minutes: 60
- location: "main conference room"
- attendees: ["marketing team"]
</think>

function.name: create_event
function.arguments: {"title": "Meeting with marketing team", "start_iso": "2024-06-05T14:00:00", "duration_minutes": 60, "location": "main conference room", "attendees": ["marketing team"]}
